description: This file provides a class 'FilterStorage' that manages persistence of recipe filter settings using shared preferences and JSON serialization.

classes.name: FilterStorage
classes.description: A utility class that handles saving, loading, and clearing recipe filter preferences using persistent storage.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads saved recipe filters from local storage, decoding from JSON to a RecipeFilters object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Asynchronously saves a RecipeFilters object to local storage as a JSON string.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Asynchronously clears the saved recipe filters from local storage.
